title: The customer's own PO is required rule does not apply when someone else pays
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with PO is required on.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, with PO is required off.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Complete, ready to invoice, billed to customer B, with Customer PO empty.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Click Create Invoice.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • Customer PO is empty.

Step 3:

  • The invoice is created without a Customer PO: customer B's rule applies.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12309 (Story 7, Invoicing to the Bill To)

  • S7-R4: “The Bill To's "PO is required" applies to Customer PO.”
  • Key Decisions: “Two customers, split by job. The customer owns pricing, tax, discounts, fees, shop supplies, history and revenue; the Bill To owns the receivable, terms, credit limit, Credit Hold, PO, deposits, payments, QuickBooks customer and IBS.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
